derivation: Only one kite is pictured: top(3,7),right(6,5),bottom(3,0),left(0,5). Seven columns and eight rows give six horizontal intervals and seven vertical intervals. Perpendicular diagonals are6in and7in, hence area6*7/2=21sq in. The large kite is described in text, not drawn. Tripling both dimensions would give189 for a different unasked kite.
